notes: Local CPU mode only (--local --device cpu), with downloads off (--offline): fetch the reader checkpoint and villa's pinned source once with `python3 spaces/ink-lens/engine.py fetch d9v2` (INKLENS_CACHE names the cache; letter weights come from kit's letter cache). Only the region is rendered, with villa's vc_render_tifxyz, which ships with VC3D. Needs numpy, tifffile and torch. The Space mode spends ZeroGPU quota and never runs from here. Ink Lens writes into its run folder only (--out), never into the segment folder.

volume.label: the open scan volume; only the region is rendered from it

crop.label: VC3D's focus region as a box on the segment's canvas (render pixels at scale 1)

voxel_um.help: the render's pixel size in micrometers (auto: from the volume)

reader.help: the ink model (both are openly licensed 9 um readers)

windows.help: depth windows (3 is steadier, 1 is faster)

map.label: the kept ink on the whole segment canvas, 0 (transparent) elsewhere

reverse.label: the reverse-depth control's kept ink under the same threshold

pins.label: letter-candidate pins (when the read is strong or weak)

letters.label: the Scroll Text Reader's output: hypotheses for a person, never a reading

receipt.label: the receipt: gate decision, reader, device, seconds, files

compute.scales_with: region area: a 1,024 px region at 9.6 um with three windows is 1,350 patches, 189 to 405 s at the 0.14 to 0.30 s per patch measured on 4 CPU cores (2026-10-20); the rendered region of a 2.4 um scan is 64 times larger on disk than at 9.6 um

vc3d.label: Ink Lens: control-checked ink map of the focus region

facts.title: ink-lens
facts.tagline: control-checked ink maps of your own region, written back into VC3D
facts.network: `vesuvius-challenge-open-data.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com` (samples, labels and tifxyz meshes), `github.com` and `codeload.github.com` (villa at a pinned commit; d9v2 and the letter weights from release assets), `huggingface.co` (`ink_9um`; the Space in Space mode). Space mode sends the region (an `.npz`) to the Space; local mode sends nothing
facts.license: Apache 2.0 for the code ([`spaces/ink-lens/LICENSE`](../../spaces/ink-lens/LICENSE), [`NOTICE`](../../spaces/ink-lens/NOTICE)); d9v2 and `ink_9um` MIT; the scans CC BY-NC 4.0
facts.success: Exit 0 with `gate.status` `ink` or `weak`; exit 3 is a valid answer (`none`), not an error.
facts.not_a_pass: A map with no status, a Space result whose status the client did not recompute, letters with
facts.never: Call a kept map or a pin a reading; publish a map, status or pin of a target or prize-eligible scroll in
